name: spsa
description: Tune UCI parameters with distributed fixed-game SPSA matches

engine.help: UCI engine executable or Enyo checkout directory available on all workers

state.help: Resumable final-theta state written on the coordinator

settings.help: Enyo settings used to resolve reproducible NNUE and Syzygy defaults

iterations.help: New sequential SPSA iterations to run from the loaded state

rounds.help: Paired opening rounds per iteration; games are twice this value

shards.help: Fixed-game match shards per iteration; defaults to available slots, capped at rounds

hash.help: Hash size in MiB for each engine process

uci.help: Common UCI option applied to both perturbations as NAME=VALUE; repeat to override settings

match_timeout.help: Timeout in seconds for one shard match

commands.name: engine
commands.command:
engine={engine}; if probe=$(printf '%s
' uci quit | "$engine" 2>/dev/null) && printf '%s
' "$probe" | grep -q uciok; then printf '%s
' "$probe"; exit 0; fi; name=$(basename "$engine"); case "$name" in enyo_*) commit=$(printf '%s
' "$name" | sed 's/^enyo_//') ;; *) echo "engine is unavailable and cannot be built automatically: $engine" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; repo=~/code/cpp/chess/enyo; git -C "$repo" fetch origin && if git -C "$repo" rev-parse --verify "$commit^{{commit}}" >/dev/null; then :; else echo "engine $engine is missing and Enyo commit $commit is unavailable in $repo; push/fetch the commit or sync a prebuilt engine to $engine" >&2; exit 1; fi; worktree="$HOME/.cache/forge/enyo-worktrees/$commit-$$"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$worktree")" && git -C "$repo" worktree add --detach "$worktree" "$commit" && trap 'git -C "$repo" worktree remove --force "$worktree" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' 0 && cd "$worktree" && ./scripts/deploy.sh --candidate && if test -x "$engine"; then printf '%s
' uci quit | "$engine"; else echo "engine build completed but did not create executable: $engine" >&2; exit 1; fi
